args.sql: SELECT p.planetref, p.hostlink, o.period FROM planets p JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON p.planetref = o.bodylink ORDER BY p.hostlink, o.period LIMIT 20;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orbital_characteristics WHERE period IS NOT NULL AND period < 10;

WITH planet_periods AS (
    SELECT p.hostlink, o.period,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.hostlink ORDER BY o.period) as rn
    FROM planets p
    JOIN orbital_characteristics o ON p.planetref = o.bodylink
    WHERE o.period IS NOT NULL
),
system_stats AS (
    SELECT hostlink, COUNT(*) as num_planets, MIN(period) as min_period
    FROM planet_periods
    GROUP BY hostlink
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
adjacent_ratios AS (
    SELECT a.hostlink, a.period::real / b.period::real as ratio
    FROM planet_periods a
    JOIN planet_periods b ON a.hostlink = b.hostlink AND a.rn = b.rn + 1
),
compact_systems AS (
    SELECT ar.hostlink
    FROM adjacent_ratios ar
    GROUP BY ar.hostlink
    HAVING MIN(ar.ratio) >= 3 OR COUNT(*) != SUM(CASE WHEN ar.ratio < 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
),
valid_systems AS (
    SELECT ss.hostlink
    FROM system_stats ss
    WHERE ss.min_period < 10
      AND ss.hostlink NOT IN (SELECT hostlink FROM compact_systems)
)
SELECT s.hostplname, AVG(ar.ratio) as avg_period_ratio
FROM valid_systems vs
JOIN stars s ON vs.hostlink = s.stellarref
JOIN adjacent_ratios ar ON vs.hostlink = ar.hostlink
GROUP BY s.hostplname;
